W38.notes: Heights scaled from slcpac005/012 (door vestibule ~3 m): colonnade ~6.7 m, band ~7.3 m, total ~14 m. The band underside slopes down ~1.5-2 m over the southern ~20 m (kink visible in slcpac001/012/019), so the colonnade is shorter at the south. Column spacing is irregular (pairs ~2.2 m apart, wide bays 4-6 m at doors), about 22 columns in all (slcpac001); bay list is read from slcpac012 and repeated, so treat exact positions as approximate. Upper fins ~0.9 m pitch (~45 across the frontal view). Street View here is 2014 (pre-construction, open lawn) and was not used. Earth 2024 W38 agrees (colonnade, finned band, penthouse).

site.courtyard: The old paved semicircular courtyard (Commons 2007-2019: curved two-storey glazing, pergolas, picnic tables, central round planter) no longer exists: the 2021 drum covers it, so it is a roof (green, with the goose-shaped pond), not a garden at ground level.

current_model_gaps: the 2021 expansion is modelled as a small brick+fins crescent/link; it is really an 83 m glass bar (W38) on a tall precast colonnade with a finned green band, a 17 m charcoal-brick climbing pavilion (W39), a black penthouse, and the bridge to MC on paired piers
W37 colonnade arm (precast columns, white fascia) is missing
the drum has a clerestory ring and the old crescent's upper ribbon shows above it

old SLC: the cafe pavilion's floating roof and cream piers (W25-W27), the W23/W24 porch and entrance, the W20 teal bay, the W13 window grid, the buff block corner (W35/W36), the Bombshelter patio with fence and gazebo, the SLC-PAC glazed corridor
hall: windows are a clerestory above the neighbouring roofs, not ground-floor windows
